title: Drive the citations extension API from VirgoZone with a private replica
acceptance: VirgoZone imports the citations package from CITATIONS_SOURCE, initializes its own SQLite under DATA_DIR/citations, and search/get/issue/resolve work through the documented run() API.
evidence: app/citations/bridge.py implements the Context protocol over data/citations with atomic 0600 writes and refuses secret keys via Settings.

tests/test_citations.py: issue, filter by person/type/status, sort by person, resolve with override, stale-revision rejection, detail receipt; replica created under the test data dir and not under the extension source.

title: Serve /citations with filters, sorting, detail, organizer actions, and comments
acceptance: GET /citations renders; /api/citations/wall filters by q, status, person, violation, offense, overdue, date range and sorts by date/person/type/status/due/comments; comments persist locally and broadcast over /ws.
evidence: Routes in app/routes/citations.py; page in app/templates/citations.html + app/static/citations.{js,css}.
Comment test: 404 for unknown citation, 201 create, listed in detail, comment_count sorted on the wall.
Firefox headless fetched status, wall, and /ws on page load (server log).

title: Push local mutations to the shared workspace without manual sync-now
acceptance: After an organizer issues a citation from the web API, pending_changes returns to 0 and the id is readable from hosaka_citations.hc_citations with no manual sync call.
evidence: Worker.notify_local_change runs sync-now after each mutation (background-tick honors next_sync_at and skipped).
db46807c-897a-41bc-ae87-6efd553ea323 issued via POST /api/citations/actions; remote_cursor 16 -> 19, pending_changes 0; independent REST read returned it with sync_revision 1.

Round trip confirmed 2026-10-25 23:16-23:17Z: citation 86720dab issued on the Hosaka-side replica, pushed (cursor 23), and pulled by VirgoZone's unattended background-tick within ~70s; row-level diff of the 0e658106 workspace showed 3/3 citations, 2/2 persons, 3/3 remedies identical with outbox pending 0 and conflicts 0. The extra cloud citation 4c1afaee belongs to a different workspace (a11ce97a-...ac01) and is correctly invisible to this replica.

title: Ship a Hosaka extension contract v1 package for VirgoZone
acceptance: hosaka extensions validate passes; linked, trusted, enabled; status and wall actions return rows from the running server; non-loopback base URLs are rejected.
evidence: hosaka-extension/ with id virgo-zone, 3 actions, Navigation UI with load, network true, filesystem data-only.
validate valid true; run status ok (3 open, 1 overdue, cursor 19); run wall listed 3 rows; configure rejected http://evil.example.

title: Exercise the wall in a real browser as guest and organizer
acceptance: A human filters/sorts, opens a detail, comments, signs in, issues and resolves a citation, and sees a second tab update live without reload.
evidence: Exercised live in integrated browser behind Hosaka Gateway (/virgo-zone/ and /virgo-zone/citations); fixed mobile .panel visibility and ordering; resolved citations synced through remote_cursor 203.

title: Commit and push the citations wall work
acceptance: virgo_zone main contains the citations routes, page, plugin, tests, and docs; .env and data/citations remain ignored.
evidence: Committed and pushed to origin/main (eb04508); 49/49 pytest tests pass; database consolidated to ~/.hosaka/extension-data/virgo-zone/virgo-zone.db.

title: Finish citations.hosaka.xyz: public origin + CITATIONS_ORIGIN
acceptance: https://citations.hosaka.xyz/ shows the wall after the access code and reads directly from Supabase when the local machine is off.
evidence: Migrated into hosaka_citations/apps/hosted-wall (rootDirectory: apps/hosted-wall), configured SUPABASE_READER_EMAIL and SUPABASE_READER_PASSWORD in Vercel Production, and verified HTTP 200 on https://citations.hosaka.xyz/api/wall.
